paper_id: Xu et al. - 2024 - AndroidLab Training and Systematic Benchmarking of Android Autonomous Agents
title: AndroidLab: Training and Systematic Benchmarking of Android Autonomous Agents
motivation: 现有基准仅测试闭源模型，缺乏开源与闭源的统一比较
problem_framing: 定义统一操作空间下的XML和SoM两种模式来公平比较LLM和LMM
key_insight: 通过指令微调可将开源模型成功率从4.59%提升至21.50%
method_signature: ANDROIDLAB环境+138任务基准+Android Instruct数据集
evaluation_criteria: 成功率、子目标成功率、反向冗余比、合理操作比
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: ReAct等复杂推理框架提升有限但推理时间大增
evidence_for_taste: complex reasoning frameworks led to marginal improvements despite significantly increased inference times
open-source models performed poorly, with the best reaching only around 5% success rate
SeeAct does not enhance performance consistently due to the model\'s reasoning limitations with multimodal input
thinking_moves: 将任务分解为多个子目标来精确评估进度
通过统一动作空间实现XML与SoM模式公平比较
用指令微调而非复杂推理框架来提升性能
